name: Kawasaki Sumire
source:
One of the girls who used to play a lot when Ayumi was young.
She has always been extremely serious, hates to lose and not so candid.
She wants to get out of the Mansion the most compared to all the other people that is trapped inside the Mansion.

Her butt seems to be very soft.
-By Miina

"I-I don't remember showing how happy I was!"

[Translated from the [url=https://www.lumpofsugar.co.jp/product/yumahorome/#modal2]official website[/url]]
